prompt: Parse a comma-separated permission string like "read,write" into an EnumSet of a nested Permission enum, and decide write access (WRITE or ADMIN grants it).
explanation: EnumSet is the purpose-built Set for enum elements: EnumSet.noneOf(Permission.class) creates an empty one, membership is a bit test, and iteration always follows declaration order -- which is why parse("write,read") still prints [READ, WRITE]. Permission.valueOf needs the exact constant name, so each trimmed piece is uppercased first, and skipping empty pieces makes the empty string parse cleanly. canWrite is then a plain contains() check against the two granting constants.
hints: Create the set with java.util.EnumSet.noneOf(Permission.class), then loop over csv.split(",").
For each piece: trim it, skip it if it is empty, and add Permission.valueOf(piece.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)).
canWrite is one boolean expression: perms.contains(Permission.WRITE) || perms.contains(Permission.ADMIN).
